description: On the table in front of you there’s a dark cup on the right, a purple toothbrush, and a small white toothpaste tube near the center. The right hand reaches into the cup to take the toothbrush as a right-hand object, while the left hand picks up the toothpaste tube as a left-hand object; the left hand brings the tube nozzle over the toothbrush head and squeezes toothpaste onto the bristles, then the right hand moves the toothbrush back toward the cup and releases it inside.
